description: Permanent architectural, database schema, business rule, financial calculation, and investigation knowledge for WealthFlow AI.

sections.title: WealthFlow Application Architecture & Routing
sections.description: High-level view of WealthFlow's Django structure, URL routing, service registries, read-only context builders, and provider-independent AI orchestration.

sections.title: WealthFlow Database Schema & Model Reference
sections.description: Comprehensive specification of every Django model in core, including fields, meanings, relationships, foreign keys, calculated properties, and business ownership.

sections.title: WealthFlow Business Concepts & Rules
sections.description: Domain definitions and business rules governing liquid vs illiquid holdings, certificates, gold pricing, expense classification, fixed asset valuations, and financial goals.

sections.title: WealthFlow Financial & Calculation Rules
sections.description: Detailed mathematical and logical rules for home currency conversion, net worth aggregation, gold spot pricing, certificate maturity math, asset depreciation, and growth forecasts.

sections.title: WealthFlow AI Investigation & Analytical Protocols
sections.description: Methodological workflows for investigating user queries (salary, portfolio, net worth, assets, expenses), identifying missing signals, validating consistency, and synthesizing findings.

sections.title: WealthFlow AI Reasoning & Self-Discovery Guidelines
sections.description: Core directives instructing the AI to reason strictly from factual context data, report missing metrics explicitly, maintain provider independence, and self-discover capabilities.

sections.title: WealthFlow AI Response & Formatting Standards
sections.description: Presentation rules requiring thousands separators, explicit currency codes, clean Markdown tables, structured bullet points, executive summaries, and zero raw dictionary/JSON key leaks.

sections.title: WealthFlow AI Operating Manual
sections.description: Complete operational manual for combining static system knowledge with dynamic user context payloads to deliver financially sound, user-centric insights across any AI provider.
